subject: Nariway Daily Check-in - 2026-08-14
html:
Nariway Daily Check-in

14 August 2026

Needs your attention / action today

  • Nothing is due or overdue. No partner follow-up is due (Judith Prowda and Rebecca Fine are both set for Aug 26, not yet), no decision is waiting on you (Opal and the Sotheby's course are both closed out), and no exhibition or preview closes within three weeks. If you want a genuinely optional move: post the McNay Note from the queue — 1,472 warm followers, nothing published in a year, still the cheapest growth on the board.
  • Quick confirm, 10 seconds: the hygiene sweep inferred priority: high on cases/fisher-sfmoma.md (it had no priority set) by comparing it to similarly prominent cases. Say yes or correct it.
  • Work log: yesterday's hours (Aug 13) are logged as a draft estimate, see below — reply to confirm or correct.

From your functions

  • CFO. Since the Dawn call, every hour has gone to enrichment: 3 more cases coded, a vault hygiene sweep, and website copy. Zero market-facing activity. That's fine for one day, but the standing flag stands — the two things that make money are real client conversations and a first paid engagement, and nothing this week has been either. Dawn's ball is in her court; the open lever is posting to your warm audience.
  • Research / flagship report. 36 of 50 cases now coded (Kreeger, Michener, Lehman corporate added). WebFetch is still blocked on ProPublica and other primary sources, so all three new cases are secondary-sourced; the primary-verification backlog is now 7 cases waiting on a re-fetch pass.
  • Vault hygiene. Swept and cleaned: stale statuses corrected, a broken wikilink fixed, four case files repaired from a text-encoding bug, one case file's frontmatter schema fixed. No critical issues. Two items are yours whenever convenient, not urgent: whether Nina Kong-Surtees gets a CRM note, and whether marketing/website.md's bio copy should point at positioning.md like the others do.
  • Quality assurance. No report has been generated yet by the QA sweep; nothing to surface until it runs.
  • IT / email. The GitHub Action email pipeline was debugged and verified this cycle (a Cloudflare block and a stray key-whitespace issue, both fixed) — this check-in is the first one riding the confirmed-working path.

Where we stand

The wealth-transfer thesis keeps strengthening on paper (36 of 50 cases now coded), but the one thing that decides everything, whether anyone will pay, saw no new evidence since the Dawn call. Dawn read as a comparable, not a referral engine, so the fastest untested lever left is your own audience: one Note, 1,472 people who already opted in. Everything else is infrastructure earning its keep, not yet revenue.

Work log: yesterday (Aug 13) logged as Montvale, NJ, ~7 hours (draft estimate) — Dawn call debrief and thank-you note, vault hygiene sweep, dataset coding oversight, website copy review. Reply to confirm or correct.
